entities.summary: Yury Mikhaylovich Kublanovsky is a Russian poet, essayist, critic and art historian. He is the author of dozens of lyrical books appearing in America, France, and Russia. He is known for his dissident past in the former Soviet Union as a member of the post-Stalinist informal literary union, SMOG.
